safety.title: Before you rely on openKWL
safety.check: openKWL is experimental. After installing, check that both fans run and that supply and exhaust air go the right way.
safety.combustion: Don't use it where a fireplace, stove or gas appliance depends on the ventilation (room-air-dependent combustion), and don't leave the unit unattended in deep frost.
safety.rollback: The original firmware is one SD card away.
